2609.18284.title: Made in Hungary: Comments on the performance of generative language models
2609.18284.paper_summary: In recent years, three initiatives have emerged to develop generative language models in Hungary. The motivation behind them is the same. For Hungarian, no model with the given capability existed, or existing English-centric models offered limited proficiency. A detailed examination of the corresponding studies, however, reveals several methodological limitations. First, the reliability of the evaluation protocols is questionable. Contrary to the findings of Csibi et al. [2026], evaluation under the recommended inference settings shows that Qwen3-4B achieves higher scores than Racka-4B, its Hungarian-adapted version. Data contamination is evident in the work of Yang et al. [2025d] and Szentmihályi et al. [2025], potentially biasing the reported results. Second, the training pipelines fall short of current best practices in corpus curation and data mixture, which risks wasting substantial compute on low-quality data. The lack of controlled ablations prevents reliable assessment of these choices. Third, none of the three papers assessed forgetting or capability loss. Testing the adapted models on a subset of the original benchmarks indicates performance decline in all three cases, especially Racka-4B. These observations emphasize the importance of rigorous experimental design in language model development, given the significant computational and financial costs involved.
2609.18284.paper_summary_zh: 近年來，匈牙利出現了三個旨在開發生成性語言模型的倡議。它們背後的動機是相同的。對於匈牙利語，並不存在具備所需能力的模型，或者現有的以英語為中心的模型提供的熟練度有限。然而，對相關研究的詳細檢查揭示了幾個方法論上的局限性。首先，評估協議的可靠性值得懷疑。與Csibi等人[2026]的發現相反，在推薦的推理設置下的評估顯示，Qwen3-4B的得分高於其匈牙利語適應版本Racka-4B。Yang等人[2025d]和Szentmihályi等人[2025]的研究中明顯存在數據污染，這可能會使報告的結果產生偏差。其次，訓練流程未達到當前語料庫策劃和數據混合的最佳實踐，這冒著在低質量數據上浪費大量計算資源的風險。缺乏受控的消融實驗使得無法可靠地評估這些選擇。第三，這三篇論文均未評估遺忘或能力損失。在原始基準的子集上測試適應模型顯示，三種情況下的表現均有下降，特別是Racka-4B。這些觀察強調了在語言模型開發中嚴謹實驗設計的重要性，考慮到涉及的重大計算和財務成本。
